description:
With over 20 years of experience and deep Colorado roots, Rebecca’s real estate business is built on connection, trust, and results. She brings a personal, relationship-focused approach to every transaction, whether you're buying your first home, selling a long-loved property, relocating across town, or exploring real estate as an investment opportunity.

Her background in marketing and project management gives clients a strategic edge, while her problem-solving mindset ensures that even the most complex situations are handled with clarity and care. Rebecca is known for staying calm under pressure and finding creative solutions tailored to each client's unique needs.

Holding designations like SFR® (Short Sale & Foreclosure Resource) and CNE® (Certified Negotiation Expert), Rebecca is equipped to handle a wide range of real estate scenarios. She serves clients from all backgrounds with a welcoming, supportive approach that helps them feel informed, comfortable, and in control throughout the process.

Above all, Rebecca believes that a home is more than just a place - it’s a reflection of your goals, lifestyle, and future. She’s honored to help clients make those dreams a reality, one home at a time.
